title: The span of a linearly independent family of k vectors has dimension k
statement: Let $F$ be a field [def-weil-field], $V$ an $F$-vector space and $v_1,\ldots,v_k\in V$ linearly independent over $F$. Then the $F$-linear span $W$ of $v_1,\ldots,v_k$ is finite-dimensional [def-weil-finite-dimensional-subspace] and $\dim_FW=k$ [def-weil-vector-space-dimension].
